title: The Fractal Forest
blurb: Interlocking frames climb above the stage with tendrils, like ferns, branches and snowflakes growing toward the treetops.

title: Unknown Relics
blurb: Strange, weathered monuments wait in the woods, a Gate and an Altar, ready to be explored and investigated.

title: The Water Serpent
blurb: A serpentine fir stage circles the audience, hung with burlap strips that glow like trout gills at night.

title: Net-Woven Ocean
blurb: Old fishing nets hang in cylinders from tall towers, catching the light behind every performer.

title: Afrofuturist Portal
blurb: Kente-cloth patterns mark the entrance portals, and Afrofuturist motifs carry through the bar, booths, stage and DJ area.
